title: PosDelivery

id.description: A unique Grubhub ID for the delivery.

account_id.description: The business account ID that was used to create the delivery.

confirmation_code.description: A Grubhub 6-character code for referencing the delivery by humans. This should be displayed to the end user for reference when calling in to Grubhub customer care. It is also provided to the driver.

name.description: Short text description for the delivery (typically, the name of the diner or delivery recipient).

flags.description: A set of flags describing certain attributes of the delivery that may impact dispatch handling.

contents.description: A list of items that are being delivered.

status.description: The current status of the delivery.

created.description: Date and time the delivery was created.

pickup_ready.description: When the order was marked as ready to be picked up. Will be absent if null.

additionalProperties.description: String map of client-supplied metadata for the delivery. Both internal Grubhub systems and partner systems may provide metadata, so it is advised to implement a namespacing convention for partner-supplied keys.

metadata.description: String map of client-supplied metadata for the delivery. Both internal Grubhub systems and partner systems may provide metadata, so it is advised to implement a namespacing convention for partner-supplied keys.

setup_instructions.description: Not currently supported through DaaS. Special instructions to the courier for delivery setup. Absent if null.

description: A delivery that has been created as the result of a delivery request.

region_code.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code, e.g. US, GB

address_lines.description: In order street address line 1, 2, etc.

items.description: In order street address line 1, 2, etc.

cross_streets.description: Usually a rough description of the intersection for delivery.

locality.description: Usually refers to postal town or city.

sublocality.description: Borough, district, an entity with an administrative boundary.

neighborhood.description:
A subdivision of sublocality, with or without a an administrative boundary.
It might also refer to a common name that is associated with the location.

administrative_area.description: State, or some sort of highest level subdivision of the region.

sorting_code.description: Not used in most regions. Sorting code for addressing purposes.

id.description: A unique ID that GrubHub has assigned to the courier

name.description: The full name of the courier

phone.description: A phone number that may be used to contact the courier

photo_url.description: A URL that can be used to see a picture of the courier

Courier.description: A courier (driver, biker, etc.) that has been assigned to execute a delivery request.

diner_id.description: UUID of the diner ordering this item

description.description: Description of the item being delivered

size.description: The size of the item from XS to XXL
enum: XS, S, M, L, XL, XXL

tags.description: Optional flags to identify various transportation constraints (alcohol, spillable, etc.) as well as any tags the customer feel like adding

items.description: Optional flags to identify various transportation constraints (alcohol, spillable, etc.) as well as any tags the customer feel like adding

quantity.description: Optional quantity with a default quantity of 1

options.description: Optional options on the item (Lettuce, Tomato, Onion, Chicken, Beef)

category_name.description: The name of the category of the item

DeliveryItem.description: An item that is being delivered.

description.description: Description of the item being delivered

tags.description: Optional flags to identify various transportation constraints (alcohol, spillable, etc.) as well as any tags the customer feel like adding

items.description: Optional flags to identify various transportation constraints (alcohol, spillable, etc.) as well as any tags the customer feel like adding

quantity.description: Optional quantity with a default quantity of 1

options.description: Optional options on the item (No, Light, Heavy)

DeliveryItemOption.description: An option on an item within a delivery

pickup_time.description: The desired time for a driver to arrive at the pickup location

delivery_time.description: The desired time for a driver to arrive at the dropoff location

DeliveryPreferences.description: A set of preferred details about a delivery

type.description: Whether or not this is an estimated time of activity or it has already taken place

timestamp.description: Time that this action occurred or is estimated to occur

DeliveryTime.description: Estimated or actual time that some activity (contents picked up or dropped off) will or has taken place.

DeliveryTimes.description: Estimated or actual times for pickup and dropoff of contents.

GeoLocation.description: Latitude and longitude coordinates for a location.

unit.description: Unit of measurement, for example, FEET, INCHES, etc.

ItemSizing.description: Size of an item within a delivery

unit.description: Unit of measurement, for example, POUNDS, OUNCES, etc.

ItemWeight.description: An item's weight range (and unit of measurement)

id.description: A unique identifier that the requesting party can send to help identify where deliveries can be batched

name.description: A short description of the location

phone.description: Telephone number for contacting this location

notes.description: Special instructions for access to the location

geofence_radius_in_meters.description: The geofence radius in meters for automated arrival

merchant_phone_suppressed.description: Flag to hide the merchant contact phone number

Location.description: Geographic and contact details for where contents will be picked up from or dropped off.

type.description: Describes the mode of transportation (car, bike, etc.)

description.description: The make, model and color of the vehicle where applicable

Vehicle.description: A vehicle used by a courier.
